title: 第7章 给本世子解释一下第8章 不太使得上劲
slug: 重生后长公主只想种田
content_zh:
;;
周荣嗤笑一声：“不可能！”
那个女人爱他如命，恨不得的将整颗心挖给他，又怎么可能会养面首。
“可是外面都传遍了？”
周荣十分自信：“不可能，不过是演戏给我看，想让我吃醋主动去找她罢了。”
开什么玩笑，本世子怎么可能会上她的当。
“等着吧，用不了多久她就会来找本世子的，毕竟中了火毒的干感受可不好，她又那么娇气的一个人，肯定受不住。”
周荣想到白日出的丑，以及痛失的火灵果，心头就憋了一口气。
除非沈青鱼向他磕头认错，保证日后不再犯错，否则他是不会帮她解毒的。
小厮欲言又止，到底还是没敢继续说。
然而周荣一夜不曾好眠，迷糊间做的梦都是把沈青鱼踩在脚底。
梦醒后一看，天都亮了，却未见有人催促。
“怎么回事，长公主府来人呢？为什么没人来喊本世子？”周荣顶着一双黑眼圈，不知为何心头惴惴不安。
下人们你看看我，我看看你，眼神都有些古怪，不敢抬眼去看周荣。
“你过来，给本世子解释一下。”周荣指着一人说道。
丝毫不怀疑是府上下人自作主张，欺凌长公主来人，毕竟平日里他们也经常这么做，他向来睁一只眼闭一只眼。
下人磨磨蹭蹭走出两步，有些结巴地说道：“回世子爷，今儿一早整个上京大街小巷都传遍了，昨夜长公主的房里闹了一整夜，叫了好几回水，天亮了都没消停。”
“你说什么？”
周荣声调提高，怀疑自己是不是听错。
下人又重复了一遍。

周荣听完顿时怒不可遏，朝下人一脚踹了下去。
“胡说八道！”
周荣不相信，沈青鱼那么爱他，怎么可能会和别的男人。
外面传的，一定是假的。
可心头却越发不安，没多会就坐不住，胡乱收拾了下便朝长公主府赶去。
心里想着，沈青鱼到底是他的正妻，虽成婚一年被他以各种理由拒绝同房，可也不能一直拖着。
不如就趁这次机会，成全了她。
前提是她要再给他寻来一株火灵草，还要接受柳晶晶嫁他为平妻，否则就继续难受着，绝不帮她解毒。
砰砰砰！
一大清早，紧闭的长公主府大门被粗暴砸响。
彼时沈青鱼才刚刚睡下，听着门外禀告，只觉得烦躁，差人去把周荣给打发了。
“你心爱的夫君来了，你不去看看？”云珏语调听着阴阳怪气的，还伸手推了沈青鱼一把。
沈青鱼被推开了，一点也不生气，又翻了回来，抱着人继续睡。
嘴里嘟嚷着：“那是你心爱的，你夫君。”
云珏被气笑了。
“沈青鱼，我从前怎不知你竟如此的不知羞耻？”
“以后就知道了。”
“你还挺自豪，当我夸你呢？”
“嗯嗯~”
云珏气得又想将她推开，却发现她早已熟睡，明明只要稍稍用力就能推开，却生出了不舍。

“哪里是娇弱胆小，分明就是个泼皮无赖。”
小龙脉挂在床顶上，看看这个，又看看那个，十分满意地撸着自己的龙须。
它果然是这天下最聪明的，拐了个最强的，还招来了一个更强的，如此还怕……

Zhou Rong sneered: "Impossible!"
That woman loved him so much that she wanted to give him her whole heart, so how could she be so handsome?
"But it's spread all over the world?"
Zhou Rong was very confident: "It's impossible, she was just acting for me to make me jealous and took the initiative to find her."
Are you kidding me? How could I be fooled by her?
"Just wait, it won't be long before she comes to see my prince. After all, it's not a good feeling to be poisoned by fire. She's such a delicate person, so she won't be able to bear it."
Zhou Rong felt a sigh of relief when he thought of the ugly appearance in the daytime and the painful loss of the Fire Spirit Fruit.
Unless Shen Qingyu kowtows to him and admits her mistake and promises not to make any more mistakes in the future, he will not help her detoxify.
The boy hesitated to speak, but finally did not dare to continue.
However, Zhou Rong didn't have a good sleep all night, and all he dreamed about was trampling on Shen Qingyu's feet.
When I woke up from the dream, I saw it was already dawn, but no one was there urging me.
"What's going on, is there someone coming from the eldest princess's mansion? Why doesn't anyone come to call me the prince?" Zhou Rong had dark circles under his eyes, feeling uneasy for some reason.
The servants looked at me and I looked at you, their eyes were a little strange and they didn't dare to raise their eyes to look at Zhou Rong.
"Come here and explain it to me," Zhou Rong pointed at a person and said.
He had no doubt that the people in the house had taken it upon themselves to bully the eldest princess. After all, they often did this on weekdays, and he had always turned a blind eye.
The servant took two steps slowly and said with some stuttering: "My lord, this morning the news spread all over the streets and alleys of Shangjing. There was a commotion in the eldest princess's room all night last night. She called for water several times and it didn't stop even after dawn."
"What did you say?"
Zhou Rong's voice rose, wondering if he heard correctly.
The servant repeated it again.
After hearing this, Zhou Rong became furious and kicked the servant down.
"Nonsense!"
Zhou Rong didn't believe that Shen Qingyu loved him so much, how could she be with another man.
What is said outside must be false.
But my heart became more and more uneasy. After a while, I couldn't sit still. I packed up and rushed towards the eldest princess' mansion.
He thought to himself that Shen Qingyu was his real wife after all. Even though he refused to have sex with her for various reasons after a year of marriage, she couldn't keep delaying it.
It's better to take advantage of this opportunity and fulfill her wish.
The premise is that she must find him another Fire Spirit Grass and accept Liu Jingjing to marry him as his equal wife. Otherwise, she will continue to suffer and will never help her detoxify.
Bang bang bang!
Early in the morning, the closed door of the eldest princess's mansion was violently smashed.
At that time, Shen Qingyu had just fallen asleep. Hearing the report outside the door, he felt irritated and sent someone to send Zhou Rong away.
"Your beloved husband is here, why don't you go and see him?" Yun Jue's tone sounded sinister, and she reached out to push Shen Qingyu.
Shen Qingyu was pushed away and was not angry at all. He rolled back and continued to sleep with his arms in his arms.
He muttered: "That is your beloved, your husband."
Yun Jue laughed angrily.
"Shen Qingyu, how could I never know that you were so shameless?"
"We'll find out later."
"You're quite proud. Do you think I'm praising you?"
"Hmm~"
Yun Jue was so angry that he wanted to push her away again, but found that she was already asleep. She could push her away with just a little force, but she felt reluctant to let her go.
"Wherever he is weak and timid, he is clearly a rogue."
The little dragon vein was hanging on the top of the bed, looking at this and that, stroking his dragon's beard with great satisfaction.
It is indeed the smartest in the world. It kidnapped the strongest and even recruited an even stronger one. How can it be so scary...
